newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM platinum group metal turnover surges in Feb.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM platinum group metal turnover surges in Feb.

text.p: The trading volume of Tokyo palladium and platinum futures jumped in February as continued delays in Russian exports to Japan triggered speculative interest in the metals, industry officials said on Monday.

Total trading volume in palladium futures on the Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) amounted to 378,428 lots in February, up 424.0 percent from January and 370.3 percent higher than the same month a year earlier, according to the Japan Federation of Commodity Exchanges.
The volume of platinum futures totalled 1,008,411 lots in February, up 105.2 percent from January but down 15.2 percent from the same month a year earlier.

"Private investors have been shifting money to platinum group metals, especially palladium, from other commodities, backed by lingering uncertainty over Russian metal supplies," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
